title: AC6761 Case 5 Revenue Process Core REA Model
scope: Official Case 5 revenue-process core model: 7 classes, 8 associations, 20 class attributes, 1 association attribute, and 16 multiplicity endpoints.
figure_caption: Source: Case 5.docx and the one-page official hand-drawn Solution of Case 5.pdf. Layout positions aid reading and do not imply sequence or causality.
assumptions: Every endpoint follows the official hand-drawn solution. Where the narrative alone is insufficient, no additional business rule is inferred.
Surfboard Inventory represents individually identified physical surfboards because the official answer gives Surfboard# as PK and permits each surfboard to participate in at most one Sale.
Cash means the concrete Cash Account class shown in the official solution and supported by Cash Account#, account type, bank name, and cash balance.
